title: Overlay render command contract v1 — FROZEN at M1
description: The only inputs the overlay renderer accepts. Everything above the overlay (step engine, planner) speaks to it exclusively through this command. The renderer NEVER reasons — it only draws what it is told. FROZEN.

pill_state.description: Drives the pill's visual state and animation. idle=collapsed; listening=mic active; thinking=planner in flight; speaking=TTS playing; guiding=highlight shown; error=fallback state.

expanded.description: Whether the assistant card is expanded. Animated independently of the highlight.

instruction.description: Text shown on the expanded card. Usually mirrors what is being spoken.

highlight.description: Where to draw the pointer, in screen pixels. null clears the highlight. Animated on its own animator, independent of pill expansion — this independence is what makes movement read as smooth.
